hook: A painter is a person who paints and a cyclist is a person who cycles: -er, -or and -ist mean a person who.

mean.stem: The suffix -er/-or/-ist most nearly means:
mean.tip: You already know -er/-or/-ist from teacher and inventor.

apply1.stem: A spectator is someone who:
apply1.tip: Spectator is spect (look) plus or (a person who). A spectator is a person who looks on and watches.

apply2.stem: A botanist is a person who:
apply2.tip: Botanist is botan (plant) plus ist (a person who). A botanist is a person who studies plants. Geo would point to rocks.
